summaries.summary: HPXPrinterDetails is an Android UI automation page class that extends SmartFlow. It provides comprehensive methods for interacting with HP printer details screen, including navigation to various printer tiles (camera scan, print photos, scan, print documents, copy, mobile fax, shortcuts, printables, print quality tools), product information retrieval (product number and serial number), printer information access (general, network, reports), and various action buttons (add device, start scan, email, rotate, etc.). The class implements swipe-based navigation patterns to locate elements and includes timeout and exception handling parameters for robust test automation.
